profile.headline: Computer systems analyst
profile.summary: Juan is a full stack software engineer who loves coding and designing solutions focused on improving the user experience using best practices to facilitate scalability and adaptation to current markets. Throughout my career I have been involved in every step of the software life cycle where I have had the opportunity and enthusiasm to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. With over eight years of experience, I’m passionate about sharing my knowledge and expertise for the benefit of my team.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Contributed as part of the development team in designing, building, and implementing innovative solutions to deliver high-quality services to clients

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to the DVI team by enhancing existing services and creating new solutions that improved user experience, streamlined backend processes, and enabled efficient data synchronization

positions.title: Consultor sr
positions.description: As part of the core team, I contributed to delivering scalable and maintainable microservices and gateways for the bank. My most significant achievement was reimplementing a critical process that streamlined operations by unifying multiple clients, improving efficiency and reducing complexity

positions.title: Arquitecto de software
positions.description: Contributed to the design, development, and implementation of a facial recognition process and an onboarding system for a major banking client
